title: Conformance case record
description: One case in a conformance suite. Required fields are the ones a third party needs to rerun the case and to tell 'decision wrong' from 'evidence absent' from 'could not decide'. `group` names the structural family the case belongs to, not its polarity: a positive case is group=positive, every other group is a mutation that must be caught.

id.description: Stable name. Renumbering breaks citations, so it must not change after release.

group.description: Structural family. Only 'positive' is a case that must not be refused; all other groups are mutations of a correct package and must be caught.

attack.description: What the case does to the input. A mutation with no stated change is an assertion, not a test.

why.description: Why this outcome is the right one. Without it the expected value is arguable instead of authoritative.

expect.description: Optional for mutations, required for positives: the coarse decision. Kept separate from expected_result because 'accept' and 'PASS' are not the same claim.

expected_result.description: The verdict value the case must produce. This, not 'expect', is what a run is compared against.

expected_checks.description: Which sub-checks must fire for a mutation. A reject for the wrong reason still counts as a reject unless this is pinned; positives carry an empty array.

path.description: Input artefacts, as a path inside the suite.

sha256.description: Digest binding the input to the case id, so artefacts cannot drift under a fixed id.
